# 3d

> Plan, build, preview and iterate production 3D for the web and Blender. Installs as an agent skill.

3d replaces the usual one-shot "make me a 3D hero" (a default scene, washed-out colour, an oversized GLB, an unchecked "looks good") with a loop: decompose intent and image/video references into a measured spec (`.3d/reference-spec.json`, schema `refspec.v1`), write an approved brief, shots and look (`.3d/brief.md`, `.3d/shots.json`, `.3d/look.json`) that pass five sign-off gates (brief, style frames, blockout, lookdev, final), choose an approach and fallback ladder, build three.js/R3F scenes, shaders, scroll-driven 3D, GLB pipelines, Blender assets, Spline, splats and AR, then show versioned previews with a captured PNG for every shot until the user approves. The SKILL.md router reads only the references the current lane names. Claude Code is the reference host; it is plain Agent Skills format (agentskills.io), so it installs on Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, opencode, Grok Build, and Hermes too.

Triggers: "3D hero", "make it look like this", "scroll-driven 3D", "optimize this GLB", "export from Blender", "black R3F scene". Commands run as `<skill>/scripts/<x>` from the project root. Not for 2D scroll/DOM animation (scroll-animation), image/video generation (generate-image, generate-video) or CAD-to-print (manufacturing-workflow).

## Install

- npm/skills.sh: `npx skills add gabros20/3d-skill`
- Clone + installer (per-host targets: claude | codex | cursor | antigravity | opencode | grok | hermes | agents | all): `git clone https://github.com/gabros20/3d-skill && cd 3d-skill && ./install.sh codex`
- Manual copy: `cp -R skills/3d ~/.claude/skills/3d`

## Tools (`<skill>/scripts/<x>`, run from the project root)

- `capabilities`: read-only preflight; writes `.3d/capabilities.md` with tools, stack, Blender and MCP hints, install proposals. Never installs.
- `ref-extract`: per reference `meta.json`, `frames/`, `contact.jpg`, `palette.json`, `luma.json`; video adds `cuts.json`, `motion.json`. Needs ffmpeg.
- `glb-report`: triangles, draw calls, textures, extensions, size against a budget (hero, world, ar); PASS/WARN/FAIL.
- `spec-check`: validates `refspec.v1`, `shots.v1` and `look.v1`; exit 1 names the bad fields.
- `preview`: `serve`, `stop`, `new-version`, `capture`, `diff A B`, `board`, `feedback` (all take `--dir`, default `.3d`); viewer with A/B and reference compare, shot captures, SSIM/PSNR, storyboard contact sheet, notes. A fresh-critic gate judges the evidence before the user sees a version.

## Reference inventory (`skills/3d/references/`, 36 files)

Front door
- `intake-grill.md` — vague request to an approved brief: rounds of at most 6 questions with recommended answers.
- `intake-references.md` — image/video references to a spec: mechanical pass plus nine vision passes.
- `refspec.md` — the `refspec.v1` schema and leaf rule.
- `refspec-mapping.md` — refspec fields to camera, light, tone, materials and post starting values.
- `brief-spec.md` — `.3d/brief.md` and `.3d/shots.json` (`shots.v1`).
- `brief-lexicon.md` — vague terms made checkable.
- `brief-approach.md` — real-time or pre-render, fallback ladder, Pipeline section.

Shared
- `shared-preflight.md` — capabilities, defaults, one batched install proposal.
- `shared-debug.md` — symptom to confirming check to one change.
- `shared-performance.md` — canonical budgets by target and frame-loop rules.
- `shared-preview.md` — versions, shot captures, the feedback loop.
- `shared-verification.md` — claim-scoped verdicts and the fresh-critic gate.

three.js, R3F and shaders
- `threejs-renderer.md`, `threejs-r3f-next.md`, `threejs-lookdev.md`, `threejs-loading.md`, `threejs-postfx.md`, `threejs-interaction.md`
- `shader-glsl.md`, `shader-tsl.md`

Scroll, design and assets
- `scroll-conductor.md`, `scroll-adapters.md`, `scroll-video.md` (pre-rendered scrub video)
- `design-art-direction.md`, `design-lookdev-presets.md`
- `asset-acquire.md`, `asset-pipeline.md`

Blender
- `blender-channels.md`, `blender-modeling.md`, `blender-lookdev-render.md`, `blender-export.md`, `blender-version-traps.md`

Optional
- `spline.md`, `splats-xr.md`, `cad-print.md`, `SOURCES.md`
